rationale: Confirm Alpha Generation, LLC as the canonical legal identity for AlphaGen and retain it as an active U.S. power-infrastructure company. Correct the corporate headquarters to Houston, add the official website, record the 2026-08-03 verification date, and update ADIA's ownership vehicle and stake to the regulator-disclosed Black Volt B 2024 LLC and 16.8%. Preserve ArcLight Energy Partners Fund VII and ADIA as active owners. The existing canonical redirect already resolves the seed-only 'Alpha Generation (AlphaGen)' identity. CPP Investments' separate duplicate task remains responsible for merging the published AlphaGen duplicate and representing its signed transaction as pending because no official closing confirmation was found.
